content.title: Rogers Corporation price target raised to $127 from $105 at B. Riley
content.summary: B. Riley analyst Craig Ellis raised the firm’s price target on Rogers Corporation (ROG) to $127 from $105 and keeps a Neutral rating on the shares. Consensus estimates for 4Q25 and 1Q26 could have a fractional upside bias if Auto and Industrial orders start to climb, the firm says. Quarterly results are expected to align with consensus estimates as new management continues to implement reacceleration initiatives, the firm says.
